canonical_interval_contract_v1.law: Downstream modules emit canonical start_seconds/end_seconds even when reading legacy aliases.

cue_lineage_contract_v1.timing_law: Semantic lineage may exist before absolute timing. Absolute timing becomes authoritative only from ACCEPTED_ALIGNMENT or LIVE_TIMELINE.

interval_classification_contract_v1.law: Level alone never authorizes repair. Classification requires timing lineage plus explicit room/cue policy; unresolved timing remains UNKNOWN.

selective_repair_contract_v1.law: Repair earliest demonstrated layer only; no blanket fill; Scene3 protected lineage stays unchanged.

rules: Never infer asset path or gain.
Output must pass regression gate before artistic/human evaluation.
room_bed_patch_renderer_contract_v1.failure: Missing binding/gain/sample-rate mismatch => HOLD, not substitution.

self_improvement_signal_contract_v1.promotion_firewall: Project success is not universal law until portability and non-duplication are demonstrated.
